description:
Activate Urza by tapping Scaretiller, adding {U}.
Scaretiller triggers, returning Vesuva from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Gods' Eye.
Put Vesuva into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Vesuva and Retreat to Coralhelm trigger.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Scaretiller.
Resolve the Vesuva trigger, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
Repeat.

uses.name: Gods' Eye, Gate to the Reikai
